speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two turnings of the glass, Master Shakespeare, and my feet have no more feeling than the flags.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The second turning is where a house remembers it is still in the porch of the matter, Mistress Ansell.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A shorter porch would leave the parish warmer in the shins. Did you reach fourteenthly, or were you elsewhere?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the fourteenthly, Mistress. It came as the sand ran out the second time.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Fourteenthly was the knot. A house is not kept by outward show. I saw your eye on Gresham's tomb before that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a great chest of stone, sir, and plainer than his fortune. The frost made it look attentive.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In the back aisle the breath went up like steam off a dye-pot. I kept my hands in my sleeves.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John may warm his feet three rows ahead and never look behind him. His baker's penny loaf still wants a full finger of the notch.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The winter is hard on the meal. Let us pray the frost breaks before Candlemas.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Prayer is good, and a full weight of bread is good beside it. Sixpence the week for firing and washing, till Lady Day, and not a scuttle stinted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have said the sixpence, Mistress. I have heard it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The shuttle goes till dusk if the coal holds. Tomorrow I am at the treadles early.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gillis makes less noise with four treadles than a man makes being quiet on my stair. The latch sprang on Saturday night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The latch was cold. I lifted it as softly as I could.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It springs louder when a man takes three steps to be quiet. You were well enough to sneeze on the way home. Do not tell me you were ill. You were not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not ill. I sneezed twice. That is not a cold.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I turn the glass twice on a Sunday in this season. Mark the fourteenth head when you are next in the pew, and not the stone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will mark it, sir. I am not ill, and I am not promising you a shorter sermon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come in out of the close, both of you. The wind will have the thread freezing on Gillis's fingers, and I will not pay for that.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have wool under the cloak, Mistress. The loom can wait until I have eaten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on in, Gillis. I will come when my feet remember they are feet.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Good day, neighbours. The fourteenthly will keep till next Sunday. It does not improve by being shouted in a porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not shout it. Two turnings is a long time to stand, and the loaf is a penny. I am going in to cut it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will eat, and then the loom. Four treadles do not freeze if the coal holds.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and a finger short. I heard you, Mistress.
